title: Evaluating Stability in Massive Social Networks: Efficient Streaming Algorithms for Structural Balance
reasoning: The paper is a technical work focused on graph streaming algorithms for structural balance testing and frustration-minimizing partitions in social networks. While it discusses 'positive and negative relations' (friendship/antagonism) within social networks, it does so from a graph-theoretic and algorithmic perspective. There is no component that evaluates or benchmarks religion, morals, or ethics.
